title: Coupled stretch–rotation laws and conditional 3D adhesion forces
evidence: Executed molecular calculations + conditional normalized 3D network transfers
limitations: No wet linked/control pair passed law transfer; hydrated network/YAP inference withheld.
AIMNet members0/3 are related models; endpoint poses are not a converged equilibrium ensemble.
YAP/gene values are assumed one-way scalar-force response laws, not biological validation.
Reference network fibers remain undeformed reference meshes; saved deformed positions/forces are interface sites only.
Coupling comparisons require common accepted seeds; missing/failed cases must remain visibly unavailable.
